40015198.author: पदार्थः
40015198.content: तत thereafter, चरा the spies, अक्षोभ्यबलम् unshakable army, तम् them, राघवम् Raghava, सुवेलेशैले Suvela mountain, निविष्टम् camped, लङ्काधिपतये to the king of Lanka, प्रत्यवेदयन् reported.

40015198.author: Translation
40015198.content: Thereafter, the spies reported to the king of Lanka that Raghava had camped with an unshakable army at the Suvela mountain.

40015199.author: पदार्थः
40015199.content: रावण Ravana, महाबलम् great army, रामम् Rama, प्राप्तम् has camped, चाराणाम् from Spies, श्रुत्वा having heard, किञ्चित् a little, जातोद्वेग felt panicky, अभवत् became, शार्दूलम् to Saardula, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40015199.author: Translation
40015199.content: On hearing from the spies that Rama has camped with a great army, Ravana got a little panicky and said these words to Saardula.

40015200.author: पदार्थः
40015200.content: निशाचर forest ranger, ते your, वर्ण colour (face colour), आयथावत् च as it should be, दीनश्च piteous, अपि and also, क्रुद्धानाम् angry, अमित्राणाम् enemies, वशम् side, नआगतःकच्चित् not come to you and done anything.

40015200.author: Translation
40015200.content: "O Forest ranger! Your face is not as it should be and also pitiable. Hope the angry enemies have not done anything to you."

40015201.author: पदार्थः
40015201.content: इति and then, तेन by him, अनुशिष्ट questioned, भयविह्वल overwhelmed by fear, शार्दूल to Saardula, तदा then, राक्षसशार्दूलम् tiger among Rakshasas, मन्दम् faint tone, वाचम् these words, उदीरयत् revealed.

40015201.author: Translation
40015201.content: And there after questioned by him (Ravana) Saardula revealed these words overwhelmed by fear, in faint tone to the tiger among Rakshasas.

40015202.author: पदार्थः
40015202.content: राजन् O king!, विक्रान्ता valiant, बलवन्तश्च highly powerful, राघवेण by Raghava, रक्षिताःच are protected also, ते with them, वानरपुङ्गवा Vanara heroes, चारयितुम् spy on, नशक्या not possible.

40015202.author: Translation
40015202.content: "O King! the Vanara heroes are valiant and highly powerful. They are also protected by Rama. It is not possible to spy on them."

40015203.author: पदार्थः
40015203.content: सम्भाषितुमपि even to converse, नशक्या not possible, अत्र there, सम्प्रश्न to question, नविद्यते not known, पन्था examine, सर्वत all over, पर्वतोपमै resembling mountains, वानरै Vanaras, रक्ष्यते guarded.

40015203.author: Translation
40015203.content: "It is not possible to converse with them or to question and or to examine, since they are guarded all over by mountains like Vanaras."

40015204.author: पदार्थः
40015204.content: तस्मिन् their, बले army, प्रविष्टमात्रे as soon as I entered into, अचारिते was observed, अहम् I, ज्ञात was detected, रक्षोभि even the guards, बलात् forcibly, गृहीत seized, बहुधा many, विचालित rolled on ground, अस्मि me.

40015204.author: Translation
40015204.content: "No sooner I entered their army, I was detected. I was forcibly seized by their guards and rolled on the ground."

40015205.author: पदार्थः
40015205.content: जानुभि with knees, मुष्टिभि with fist, दन्ते with teeth, तलैश्च and even with palms, भृशम् intensely, अभिहत beaten, अमर्षणै indignantly, हरिभि the monkeys, बलवद्भि in the army, परिणीत paraded, आस्मि me.

40015205.author: Translation
40015205.content: "The monkeys had beaten me with fists, bitten my palms with teeth, beaten me intensely and paraded me in the army indignantly."

40015206.author: पदार्थः
40015206.content: रुधिरादिग्धसर्वाङ्ग all limbs bleeding, विह्वल lost senses, चलितेन्द्रिय lost control of limbs, अहम् I, सर्वत्रपरिणीय all over paraded, रामसंसदम् to the assembly of Rama, नीत led.

40015206.author: Translation
40015206.content: "With all my limbs wet with bleeding, control over senses lost, after parading, I was led to the assembly of Rama."

40015207.author: पदार्थः
40015207.content: हरिभि monkeys also, वध्यमान smitten, कृताञ्जलि offering salutation with folded palms, याचमान pleading, राघवेण from Raghava, परित्रात protection, यदृच्छया by chance, जीवामीति alive.

40015207.author: Translation
40015207.content: "While smitten by the monkeys, offering salutation with folded hands, and pleading for protection from Raghava, luckily, I am alive."

40015208.author: पदार्थः
40015208.content: एष that way, राम Rama, शैलै rocks, शिलाभिश्च and even stones, महावर्णवम् great ocean, पूरयित्वा filled, सायुध equipped with arms, लङ्काया Lanka's, द्वारम् entrance, आश्रित्य taking position, तिष्ठति stands.

40015208.author: Translation
40015208.content: "Having filled the great ocean with rocks and stones in that way, taking position at the entrance of Lanka Rama stands equipped with arms."

40015209.author: पदार्थः
40015209.content: महातेजा O glorious one, माम् me, विसृज्य freeing, हरिभि even monkeys, गरुडव्यूहम् in the form of Garuda, आस्थाय forming, पर्वत mountain, वृत surrounded, लङ्कामेव into Lanka, अभिवर्तते is advancing.

40015209.author: Translation
40015209.content: "O glorious King! After releasing me, Rama is advancing into Lanka surrounded by mountains like a monkey army in the form of Garuda."

40015210.author: पदार्थः
40015210.content: प्राकारम् boundary, पुराआयाति before reaching, क्षिप्रम् quickly, एकतरम् one thing, कुरु do, आशु you will, सीतांवा either Sita, प्रयच्छ set out, युद्धंवास्मै good war, प्रदीयताम् to give.

40015210.author: Translation
40015210.content: "Before Rama reaches the boundary, the wall, do one thing quickly. Either give away Sita or set out to give a good war."

40015211.author: पदार्थः
40015211.content: राक्षसाधिप Rakshasa king, स that, रावण Ravana, तदा then, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, मनसा in his mind, तत् that, प्रेक्ष्य reviewing, अथ and then, शार्दूलम् Saardula, सुमहत् a good, वाक्यम् statement, उवाच uttered.

40015211.author: Translation
40015211.content: "Having heard what has been said by Saardula, Rakshasa king reviewed in his mind and made a good statement before Saardula."

40015212.author: पदार्थः
40015212.content: यदि even if, देवगन्धर्वदानव Devas Gandharvas, Danavas, मांप्रतियुध्येरन come to wage war with me, सीतां Sita, प्रदास्यामि give away, सर्वलोकभयादपि threat from all worlds, नैव will not.

40015212.author: Translation
40015212.content: "Even if Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas come to wage war with me and even if I have threats from all worlds, I will not give away Sita."

40015213.author: पदार्थः
40015213.content: महातेजाः glorious, रावणः Ravana, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said, भवता by you, सेना army, चरिता went about, अत्र there, शूराः warriors, प्लवङ्गमाः among the monkeys.

40015213.author: Translation
40015213.content: Glorious Ravana having spoken like that, again said (to Saardula), "You moved about in the army (camp) there. Tell me who among the monkeys are warriors?"

40015214.author: पदार्थः
40015214.content: राक्षस Rakshasa, सौम्य gentle one, दुरासदा difficult to encounter, ये those, वानरा Vanaras, किम् प्रभा who are the powerful ones?, कीदृशा of what kind कस्य whose, पुत्रा sons (are they?), पौत्राश्च grandsons (are they?), तत् it, त्वम् you, आख्याहि may speak of.

40015214.author: Translation
40015214.content: "Gentle Saardula! Of those who are difficult to encounter, what is their description? Who are the powerful ones among them? Whose sons and grandsons, are they? You may speak."

40015215.author: पदार्थः
40015215.content: तेषाम् their, बलाबलम् strength and weakness, ज्ञात्वा knowing, अत्र here, तथा likewise, प्रतिपत्स्यामि I would like to know what to do, युद्धम् war, इच्छताम् desiring, सङ् ख्यानम् their numbers, अवश्यम् essential, बल strength, कर्तव्यं it is essential.

40015215.author: Translation
40015215.content: "Likewise knowing their strengths and weaknesses from you I wish to know what to do. It is essential to know their numbers and strength before the war."

40015216.author: पदार्थः
40015216.content: अथ and now, रावणेन by Ravana, एवम् that way, उक्त having spoken, उत्तमःचर good spy, शार्दूल Saardula, रावणसन्निधौ in the presence of Ravana, इदम् thus, वचनम् these words, वक्तुम् to tell, आरेभे proceeded.

40015216.author: Translation
40015216.content: "When Ravana had spoken that way, good spy Saardula proceeded to tell these words in the presence of Ravana."

40015217.author: पदार्थः
40015217.content: अथ and then, र्क्षरजसः Rksaraja's, पुत्रो son, in war, राजा king, सुदुर्जयः difficult to win over, युधि in war, विश्रुतः widely known, जाम्बवानिति he is known as Jambavan गद्गदस्याथ Gadgada's पुत्त्रोऽत्र son.

40015217.author: Translation
40015217.content: "Certainly, king Sugriva, the son of Rksharaja's, is difficult to be conquered in battle. Here is the son of Gadgada, famously called as Jambavan."

40015218.author: पदार्थः
40015218.content: आन्य another, गद्गदस्यैव Gadgada's, पुत्त्र son, शतक्रतो an epithet of Indra, (known as Dhumra), गुरुपुत्र son of Brhaspati, (Kesari), यस्य his, पुत्रेण by his son Hanuman, एकेन alone, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, कदनम् killing of many, कृतम् did.

40015218.author: Translation
40015218.content: Another son of Gadgada is Dhumra. One who killed many Rakshasas is Hanuman, the son of Kesari, who is the son of Brhaspati.

40015219.author: पदार्थः
40015219.content: राजन् O king!, धर्मात्म righteous self, पुत्र son, वीर्यवान् a valiant one, धर्मास्य of the Lord of death (Yamadharma), सुषेणश्च Sushena, अत्र here, स्सोमात्मज moon's son, सौम्य noble, कपि Vanara, अत्र here, दधिमुख Dadhimukha.

40015219.author: Translation
40015219.content: "O king! Here is a heroic and righteous Sushena, the son of the Lord of death (Yamadharma). Here is Dadhimukha son of noble moon."

40015220.author: पदार्थः
40015220.content: सुमुख Sumukha, दुर्मुखश्चात्र Durmukha, वेगदर्शीच Vegadarsi, वानर Vanaras, नूनम् surely, स्वयम्भुवा by the selfborn (Lord Brahma), वानररूपेण in Vanara form, सृष्ट created, मृत्यु God of death.

40015220.author: Translation
40015220.content: "Vanaras Sumukha, Durmukha and Vegadarsi are surely created by Brahma in the Vanara form of DeathGod."

40015221.author: पदार्थः
40015221.content: हुतवहस्य fire god's, पुत्त्र son, स्वयम् himself, सेनापति army chief, नील Nila, अथ here, हनूमानिति is Hanuman, विश्रुत widely known, अनिलस्यपुत्र son of wind god.

40015221.author: Translation
40015221.content: "The firegod's son indeed is the army chief known as Nila, and here is windgod's son widely known as Hanuman."

40015222.author: पदार्थः
40015222.content: शक्रस्य Indra's, नप्ता grandson, दुर्धर्ष indomitable, बलवान् powerful, युवा young, अङ्गद Angada, आश्विसम्भवौ twins born of Ashwini, बलिना strong, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्च and Dwivida, उभौ both, अथ now, वैनस्वतस्य Vynaswathasya's (Yama, the Lord of death ), पुत्त्रा sons, कालान्तकोपमा resemble god of death (spirit of time), गज: Gaja, गवाक्ष: Gavaksha, गवय: Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पञ्च five, शूराणाम् heroes, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् desiring to wage war, दश ten, वानरकोट्यश्च crores of Vanaras, श्रीमताम् prosperous, देवपुत्राणाम् sons of gods, शेषम् remaining ones, आख्यातुम् to speak, नउत्सहे not possible.

40015222.author: Translation
40015222.content: "The indomitable and powerful young Angada is the grandson of Indra, the strong Mainda and Dwivida are both the twin sons of Ashwini Devas, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha and Gandhamadana are the five sons of Yama, the god of death. There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."

40015223.author: पदार्थः
40015223.content: शक्रस्य Indra's, नप्ता grandson, दुर्धर्ष indomitable, बलवान् powerful, युवा young, अङ्गद Angada, आश्विसम्भवौ twins born of Ashwini, बलिना strong, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्च and Dwivida, उभौ both, अथ now, वैनस्वतस्य Vynaswathasya's (Yama, the Lord of death ), पुत्त्रा sons, कालान्तकोपमा resemble god of death (spirit of time), गज: Gaja, गवाक्ष: Gavaksha, गवय: Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पञ्च five, शूराणाम् heroes, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् desiring to wage war, दश ten, वानरकोट्यश्च crores of Vanaras, श्रीमताम् prosperous, देवपुत्राणाम् sons of gods, शेषम् remaining ones, आख्यातुम् to speak, नउत्सहे not possible.

40015223.author: Translation
40015223.content: "The indomitable and powerful young Angada is the grandson of Indra, the strong Mainda and Dwivida are both the twin sons of Ashwini Devas, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha and Gandhamadana are the five sons of Yama, the god of death. There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."

40015224.author: पदार्थः
40015224.content: शक्रस्य Indra's, नप्ता grandson, दुर्धर्ष indomitable, बलवान् powerful, युवा young, अङ्गद Angada, आश्विसम्भवौ twins born of Ashwini, बलिना strong, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्च and Dwivida, उभौ both, अथ now, वैनस्वतस्य Vynaswathasya's (Yama, the Lord of death ), पुत्त्रा sons, कालान्तकोपमा resemble god of death (spirit of time), गज: Gaja, गवाक्ष: Gavaksha, गवय: Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पञ्च five, शूराणाम् heroes, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् desiring to wage war, दश ten, वानरकोट्यश्च crores of Vanaras, श्रीमताम् prosperous, देवपुत्राणाम् sons of gods, शेषम् remaining ones, आख्यातुम् to speak, नउत्सहे not possible.

40015224.author: Translation
40015224.content: "The indomitable and powerful young Angada is the grandson of Indra, the strong Mainda and Dwivida are both the twin sons of Ashwini Devas, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha and Gandhamadana are the five sons of Yama, the god of death. There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."

40015225.author: पदार्थः
40015225.content: सिंहसंहनन built like lion in form, एष that, युवा young one, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, पुत्त्र son, त्रिशिरा Trisira.

40015225.author: Translation
40015225.content: "That young one whose build is like a lion is Dasaratha's son who slayed Dushana, even Khara, like wise Trisira."

40015226.author: पदार्थः
40015226.content: येन by whom, विराध Viradha, निहत was killed, अन्तकोपम one like Lord of death, कबन्धश्च even Kabhanda, रामस्य Rama's, विक्रमे by valour, सदृश equal, कश्चन perhaps, भूवि in this world, नास्ति not.

40015226.author: Translation
40015226.content: "Viradha and even Kabhanda who was like the Lord of death were killed by Rama. Perhaps there is none equal to Rama in valour in this world."

40015227.author: पदार्थः
40015227.content: येन by whom, जनस्थानगता approaching Janasthana, यावन्त all, राक्षसा Rakshasas, हता were killed, रामस्य by Rama, गुणान् virtues, वक्तुम् to speak of, नर human, कश्चित् even, क्षितौ to recount, नशक्त not possible.

40015227.author: Translation
40015227.content: "It is not even possible to recount the virtues of Rama who killed all the Rakshasas approaching Janasthana."

40015228.author: पदार्थः
40015228.content: यस्य his, बाणपथम् within the range of arrows, प्राप्य strike, वासवःअपि even Indra, नजीवेत् not be alive, धर्मात्मा righteous, मातङ्गानाम् proud elephant, ऋषभःइव like a bull, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana's, अत्र here.

40015228.author: Translation
40015228.content: "Here is righteous Lakshmana, who is like a bull (foremost) resembling a proud elephant. Even Indra will not be alive with in the range of his arrows when he strikes."

40015229.author: पदार्थः
40015229.content: भास्करस्य Sun god's, आत्मसम्भवौ sprung from Sun god, श्वेत Swetha, ज्योतिर्मुखश्च Jyothirmukha, वरुणस्य Varuna's, अन्यःपुत्त्र other son, हेमकूट Hemakuta, प्लवङ्गम monkey, विश्वकर्मसुत son of Vishwakarma, वीर heroes, प्लवगसत्तम foremost among the monkeys, नल Nala, विक्रान्त valiant, बलवान् gallant, वसुपुत्र son of Vasu, विक्रान्त valiant, वेगवान् swift in action, वसुपुत्त्र son of Vasu, स he, दुर्धर is Durdhara, अत्र here.

40015229.author: Translation
40015229.content: "Here are Swetha and Jyothirmukha sons of Sun god Hemakuta another son of Varuna Nala the foremost among the monkey heroes is the valiant son of Vishwakarma and Durdhara of swift action, the son of Vasu."

40015230.author: पदार्थः
40015230.content: भास्करस्य Sun god's, आत्मसम्भवौ sprung from Sun god, श्वेत Swetha, ज्योतिर्मुखश्च Jyothirmukha, वरुणस्य Varuna's, अन्यःपुत्त्र other son, हेमकूट Hemakuta, प्लवङ्गम monkey, विश्वकर्मसुत son of Vishwakarma, वीर heroes, प्लवगसत्तम foremost among the monkeys, नल Nala, विक्रान्त valiant, बलवान् gallant, वसुपुत्र son of Vasu, विक्रान्त valiant, वेगवान् swift in action, वसुपुत्त्र son of Vasu, स he, दुर्धर is Durdhara, अत्र here.

40015230.author: Translation
40015230.content: "Here are Swetha and Jyothirmukha sons of Sun god Hemakuta another son of Varuna Nala the foremost among the monkey heroes is the valiant son of Vishwakarma and Durdhara of swift action, the son of Vasu."

40015231.author: पदार्थः
40015231.content: राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, वरिष्ठश्च jewel, तव your, भ्राता brother, विभीषण Vibheeshana, राघवस्य Raghava's, हिते wellwisher, रत remains, लङ्कापुरीम् city of Lanka, प्रतिगृह्य received.

40015231.author: Translation
40015231.content: "Here is your brother Vibheeshana the jewel among Rakshasas, who remains as a wellwisher of Rama and has received the city of Lanka (to whom Rama has offered Lanka)."

40015232.author: पदार्थः
40015232.content: इति this, सुवेलेशैले on Suvela mountain, अधिष्ठितम् stationed, इदम् thus, सर्वम् everything, वानरंबलम् Vanara strength, तवइदं to you this, समाख्यातम् described, शेषकार्ये rest of the task, भवान् your, गति decide.

40015232.author: Translation
40015232.content: "I have described to you everything about the Vanara strength stationed on Suvela mountain. You may decide the rest of the task to be done." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirtieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
